limitations: Six run pairs give limited uncertainty resolution; the smallest attainable nonzero two-sided sign-flip p-value is 0.03125.
The percentile bootstrap resamples pairs, not individual frames; exchangeability and approximate pair independence remain assumptions.
Total wall time is primary. Per-stage CPU, hardware and tail summaries are exploratory secondary results without multiplicity correction.
The last pair has a much larger total gain than the first five; post-hoc exclusion is sensitivity only and does not replace the complete primary result.
All frames and outliers are retained. Pooled quantiles are descriptive and do not supply independent trial replication.
Per-buffer clocks were disabled, so lock/memcpy/unlock contributions cannot be separated here.
Both variants use imported buffers for all native inputs; the proposed app experiment keeps managed inputs unchanged and must be evaluated separately.
Earlier unpaired native/app means belong to different session conditions and cannot establish allocation effects.
Thermal status 0 does not prove identical frequency, scheduling or competing workloads.
Native fixed-input checks do not qualify recurrent app behavior, direct vehicle USB, wake response or hours-long thermal performance.
